blurb: Capital Musky offers guided musky fishing charters on the Ottawa River using proven techniques and all necessary equipment. They emphasize conservation and proper fish handling to protect the musky fishery. Trips are available for all experience levels, including beginner introductions and hardcore angler hunts.
